meta.name: kpalette
meta.author: Kanj
meta.description:
A complete 4-bit RGB color palette (4096 colors) implemented as Mindustry items for pixel art via sorter abuse.

Each color is named by its hex code (000-fff) and expands to full 8-bit representation:
- #f00 → #FF0000 (pure red)
- #888 → #888888 (mid gray)
- #5d8 → #55DD88 (mint green)

Warning: Loading 4096 items may impact performance on lower-end devices. If the game lags, consider not using this mod.

v1.0.0 - Initial release
